I am a data science student at Brigham Young University–Idaho,
graduating in December 2026. I enjoy turning messy data into
useful insights and building tools that make analysis easier.

My interests include machine learning, data pipelines, and
applications in health and wellness.

## Featured project

### Stress or Exercise?

Can wearable-device data help distinguish mental stress from
physical activity?

For my senior project, I am exploring physiological recordings,
developing a classification model, and building a Python
package for preparing wearable data.

**Current stage:** Dataset downloaded; beginning exploration.

[Explore the project and read my updates](senior-project.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}

## Background

My experience includes leading a student data-pipeline project
for the City of Ammon and serving as VP of Communications and
a mentor in the BYU–Idaho Data Science Society.
